mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate rate hikes to curb inflation.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-inflation spike mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 new jobs monthly signals labor market strength that supports equity valuations, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 5-year period, 60-day forward returns are negative when PAYEMS > 150000 (out-of-sample test).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of at least 5 points suggests weakening demand, which precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and INDPRO current < INDPRO two months ago by ≥5
failure_condition: In 10 such contraction episodes, 20-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the monthly RSAFS (retail sales) below 500 million dollars indicates softening demand, which interacts with low FEDFUNDS to produce a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: soft demand coupled with easing policy
failure_condition: In 20 such events, 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3% for three consecutive months indicates labor market softening, which predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: Over 12 such cooling periods, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (housing starts) above 1,200 units suggests building optimism in the housing market, which interacts with low FEDFUNDS to drive a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: In 10 such events, 60-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in GDPC1 (GDP) above 20,000 billion chained USD for two consecutive quarters signals economic expansion, producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Over 50 such growth quarters, 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive declines in both CPIAUCSL (>2%) and INDPRO (<100) indicate dual pressures on costs and demand, which together produce a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return in such regimes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In 8 such episodes, 5-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).
